sections.bio:
I build growth systems by combining creativity, AI, technology, and marketing to help businesses attract, convert, and retain customers.
 
Over the last 15+ years, I've worked across Gaming, FinTech, and Consumer Tech, leading creative teams, building brands, launching products, and developing customer acquisition strategies that improve conversions, lower customer acquisition costs (CAC), increase marketing ROI, and create sustainable growth.
 
Today, I build Business Growth Systems that combine creativity, AI, automation, and performance marketing into one scalable engine.
 
These systems bring together high-converting landing pages, CRM & email automation, conversion funnels, AI-powered creative production, SEO, AEO & GEO, performance marketing creatives, personalized outreach, and analytics to create a repeatable customer acquisition process.
 
The goal is simple: build a growth engine that attracts visitors, converts them into customers, and scales businesses through systems—not constant manual effort.
 
I've always believed great creative should solve business problems.
 
Whether it's an advertising campaign, landing page, website, product launch, video, or brand strategy, every piece should have one purpose: attract the right audience, build trust, improve conversions, and deliver measurable business impact.
 
As a former Chief Growth Officer and Creative Director, I've led cross-functional teams of 45+ professionals, built in-house creative operations, launched products, developed brand systems, and partnered closely with product, engineering, marketing, sales, and leadership teams to turn ideas into business outcomes.
 
I also write Skip the MBA, a free weekly newsletter.
 
Every Tuesday, I publish a 5-minute letter for founders who refuse to stop building—covering what most MBAs skip: patience, focus, identity, visibility, creativity, and courage.
 
I'm always interested in conversations with founders and leadership teams building products where creativity, AI, technology, and growth come together to create exceptional businesses.
 
Open to: Creative Director • Director of Design • Director of Growth Marketing • Head of Marketing • VP Marketing • Chief Growth Officer (CGO)
